name: Strategy bot planning order (alternate)
_alternate: Changed from the standard order (GC72_PrimaryOrder): no Hold SCs and no Capture SCs primary steps -- the alternate bots skip both; every other step and share as the standard order's.
_note: The planner works through `steps` in order, each after taking `budget_share` of its planning budget; treasonous_capture only runs when the bot means to betray its alliance this turn. The secondary objectives come next (each taking secondary_budget_share, in an order drawn by the strategy weights), then `final`.
